response.sql:
WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        z.city,
        COUNT(*) as count
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    GROUP BY z.city
),
city_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        city,
        count,
        count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM city_counts) as share
    FROM city_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
    FROM city_shares
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.city,
        cs.count,
        cs.share,
        asc.avg_share,
        cs.share - asc.avg_share as above_avg
    FROM city_shares cs
    CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
    WHERE cs.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT 
    AVG(count) as avg_count,
    AVG(share) as avg_share,
    AVG(above_avg) as avg_above_average
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: All members referenced in the attendance table have non-NULL zip codes that exist in the zip_code table. Attendance records linked to members without valid zip codes are excluded from analysis.

alternatives.interpretation: Group by (city, state) instead of city alone to distinguish cities with identical names in different states, treating each geographic city separately.
